g.text: Does a 20-batch monitoring run raise a false alarm?
No introduced change. Points show observed proportions; bars show 95% Wilson intervals. Dashed line: 5% target. Per-batch PSI and fixed PSI 0.1
are ablations without horizon control. Outcome and combined monitors include labels.
